delivery_issue.description: Late, missing, delayed, or incorrectly tracked delivery
examples: The parcel was out for delivery but never arrived

delivery_date_confusion.description: Confusion about the promised or displayed delivery date
examples: One day delivery is showing a later date
Why has my delivery date changed?

refund_cancellation.description: Request to cancel an order or receive a refund
examples: I want to cancel my order
How can I get a refund?

product_replacement.description: Damaged, defective, missing, or incorrect product

prime_membership_billing.description: Prime membership, free trial, renewal, subscription, or unexpected charge
examples: I was charged after my Prime trial
Why was my Prime membership renewed?
I want to cancel my Prime subscription

account_order_privacy.description: Account access, order details, personal information, or publicly shared order information
examples: I posted my order number publicly

technical_device_issue.description: App, website, Alexa, device, or other technical problem

digital_content_support.description: Prime Video, Kindle, digital content, or other digital services

general_feedback.description: General complaints, appreciation, or messages without a specific support issue
